items.title: Sanmina beats earnings estimates as AI and cloud manufacturing expands
items.summary: Sanmina reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $3.86 billion and adjusted EPS of $4.43, exceeding analyst estimates. AI and cloud revenue expanded 179% year over year, supported by ZT Systems integration. Shares rose sharply in premarket trading, but acquisition-driven growth, concentration and margins remain key durability tests.

observations.label: Market move
observations.value: SANM approximately +15.9% in Nov 10 premarket report; not verified at research completion

items.key_finding: The AI infrastructure spending cycle is translating into strong EMS earnings, although acquisition integration and margin durability matter.

sources.title: Barron's Sanmina earnings and AI growth, Nov 10

items.title: Infineon raises FY2027 data-center power chip revenue forecast to nearly EUR 4 billion
items.summary: Infineon guided to nearly EUR 4 billion of FY2027 data-center power-supply revenue, up from an earlier roughly EUR 2.5 billion outlook. It forecasts approximately EUR 20 billion total revenue versus EUR 16.35 billion in FY2026. Shares rose on the announcement, while auto demand, manufacturing expansion and spending requirements remain execution risks.

observations.label: FY2027 data-center power revenue forecast
observations.value: Close to EUR 4 billion; previous outlook approximately EUR 2.5 billion

observations.label: Market move
observations.value: IFX.DE approximately +6.47% at Nov 10 10:55 CET (4:55 AM EST); not current market quote

items.key_finding: Infineon's materially higher data-center power target reinforces demand for power electronics behind AI and grid buildouts.

items.title: October headline CPI rises 0.4% month on month, pressuring growth equities
items.summary: The BLS reported October headline CPI up 0.4% month on month, core up 0.3%, and shelter up 0.3%. The headline reading exceeded a widely reported 0.3% consensus, while equities weakened amid renewed interest-rate concerns. Because October 2025 observations were unavailable, the BLS cannot publish most October 2026 year-over-year CPI changes.

observations.label: Annual CPI
observations.value: Most 12-month comparisons unavailable because October 2025 collection was suspended

observations.label: Market response
observations.value: Tuesday equities lower in contemporaneous reporting; no independently verified timestamped index percentage

items.key_finding: Inflation surprise increases rate sensitivity of growth equities; missing year-earlier data constrain annual comparisons.

items.title: Brent breaks below $90 amid Iran de-escalation despite persistent Hormuz security risk
items.summary: Reuters reported Brent at $89.65 and WTI at $84.52 at 13:34 GMT on November 10, extending Monday's sharp oil selloff. Presidential restraint comments reduced escalation fears, while UKMTO's latest displayed incidents remained dated November 8. Neither newly restored normal tanker transit nor incremental physical oil supply loss was verified.

observations.label: Price observation
observations.value: November 10, 2026, 13:34 GMT / 8:34 AM EST; intraday futures

observations.label: Physical transit and supply change
observations.value: No new verified normalization or incremental loss established

items.key_finding: Oil risk premium is compressing despite unresolved maritime threats; monitor actual tanker flows and EIA/API inventories.

items.title: Digital Turbine drops sharply after earnings despite sales growth
items.summary: Digital Turbine shares fell sharply after hours despite strong reported revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth. Rising revenue-sharing costs cut non-GAAP gross margin, and management disclosed a prior-period expense correction assessed as immaterial. The selloff highlights uncertainty over partner economics and durable cash conversion.
